list.name: activate_document
list.summary: Make an already-open document the active one, so the next tools act on it.

list.name: add_annotation
list.summary: Add an annotation (a note, balloon or surface-finish symbol) to the active drawing.

list.name: add_arc
list.summary: Draw a circular arc in the open sketch from its centre, start point and end point, in mm.

list.name: add_centerline
list.summary: Draw a centreline (construction line) in the open sketch, in mm.

list.name: add_chamfer
list.summary: Bevel edges of the active part with a chamfer: `distance` along one face at `angle` (45 by default).

list.name: add_circle
list.summary: Draw a circle in the open sketch from its centre and radius, in mm.

list.name: add_datum_tag
list.summary: Add a datum feature symbol (A, B, C, ...) on an edge of the active drawing.

list.name: add_dimension
list.summary: Add one dimension between drawing entities at a position on the sheet.

list.name: add_drawing_view
list.summary: Place one named view of a part or assembly on the active drawing sheet; the same as `create_drawing_view`.

list.name: add_ellipse
list.summary: Draw an ellipse in the open sketch from its centre and axis lengths, in mm.

list.name: add_fillet
list.summary: Round edges of the active part with a constant-radius fillet.

list.name: add_gtol
list.summary: Add a GD&T feature control frame to the active drawing, e.g. position Ø0.2 (M) to A|B|C.

list.name: add_line
list.summary: Draw a straight line between two points in the open sketch, in mm.

list.name: add_mate
list.summary: Mate two components of the active assembly: coincident, concentric, parallel, perpendicular, tangent, distance or angle.

list.name: add_note
list.summary: Place a text note on the active drawing sheet at a position in millimetres.

list.name: add_polygon
list.summary: Draw a regular polygon (e.g. a hexagon) in the open sketch from its centre, radius and number of sides.

list.name: add_rectangle
list.summary: Draw a closed, axis-aligned rectangle in the open sketch from two opposite corners, in mm.

list.name: add_sketch_constraint
list.summary: Add a geometric relation between sketch entities: horizontal, vertical, parallel, perpendicular, tangent, coincident, concentric, equal, symmetric, collinear or fix.

list.name: add_sketch_dimension
list.summary: Add a driving dimension to sketch entities: linear, angular, radial or diameter.

list.name: add_spline
list.summary: Draw a smooth spline through a list of points in the open sketch, in mm.

list.name: analyze_drawing_annotations
list.summary: Check a drawing's notes, symbols and text styles for consistency.

list.name: analyze_drawing_comprehensive
list.summary: Run every drawing check (dimensions, views, annotations, standards) on a drawing file in one call.

list.name: analyze_drawing_dimensions
list.summary: Check a drawing's dimensions for consistent precision, tolerance formatting and completeness.

list.name: analyze_drawing_views
list.summary: Check how a drawing's views are chosen and laid out.

list.name: analyze_geometry
list.summary: Run a geometry analysis on the active model, such as curvature, draft or wall thickness.

list.name: analyze_macro
list.summary: Analyse a macro's structure, dependencies and complexity, and suggest optimisations.

list.name: apply_template
list.summary: Apply a saved template's properties, dimensions and materials to a model.

list.name: arrange_dimensions
list.summary: Move drawing dimensions out of their views into tidy rows so nothing overlaps, then check the sheet.

list.name: auto_center_marks
list.summary: Insert centre marks on the holes, slots and (optionally) fillets of one drawing view.

list.name: auto_dimension_view
list.summary: Dimension a drawing view automatically with SolidWorks' auto-dimension scheme.

list.name: automation_start_macro_recording
list.summary: Start SolidWorks' macro recorder (the automation family's copy of `start_macro_recording`).

list.name: automation_stop_macro_recording
list.summary: Stop a macro recording and save it (the automation family's copy of `stop_macro_recording`).

list.name: batch_apply_template
list.summary: Apply one template to every matching model in a folder.

list.name: batch_execute_macros
list.summary: Run several macros in sequence against the files in a folder.

list.name: batch_export
list.summary: Export every matching SolidWorks file in a folder to one format.

list.name: batch_file_operations
list.summary: Copy, move, rename or delete SolidWorks files on disk in one call.

list.name: batch_process_files
list.summary: Run one operation (rebuild, save as, export or property update) on every matching file in a folder.

list.name: calculate_mass_properties
list.summary: Measure the active part or assembly's mass properties: volume, surface area, mass, centre of mass and moments of inertia.

list.name: check_drawing_compliance
list.summary: Check a drawing's title block and sheet format against a drafting standard (ISO, ANSI or DIN).

list.name: check_drawing_standards
list.summary: Check the active drawing against a drafting standard and score it.

list.name: check_interference
list.summary: Find where the components of the active assembly overlap (Tools > Interference Detection).

list.name: check_sketch_fully_defined
list.summary: Check whether a sketch is fully defined, under-defined or over-defined.

list.name: classify_feature_tree
list.summary: Classify the active model's kind (part, sheet metal, assembly, drawing and so on) from its feature tree, and suggest how to work on it.

list.name: close_model
list.summary: Close the active document, saving it first only if asked.

list.name: compare_drawing_versions
list.summary: Compare two drawing files on disk: whether they are byte-identical, and how their sizes differ.

list.name: compare_templates
list.summary: Compare two template files on disk: whether they are byte-identical, and how their sizes differ.

list.name: convert_file_format
list.summary: Convert a SolidWorks file on disk to another format without opening it first.

list.name: create_assembly
list.summary: Create a new, empty assembly document and make it active, ready for `insert_component`.

list.name: create_axis
list.summary: Add a reference axis along the model's x, y or z direction, through the origin.

list.name: create_cut_extrude
list.summary: Cut material from the active part with a closed sketch profile: holes, slots, windows.

list.name: create_detail_view
list.summary: Magnify a circular area of a drawing view as a detail view.

list.name: create_drawing
list.summary: Create a new, empty drawing document and make it active.

list.name: create_drawing_view
list.summary: Place one named view of a part or assembly on the active drawing sheet.

list.name: create_extrusion
list.summary: Extrude the sketch you just closed into a solid boss, added to the active part.

list.name: create_loft
list.summary: Loft a solid through two or more closed profile sketches, in order (Insert > Boss/Base > Loft).

list.name: create_macro_library
list.summary: Set up a shared folder of categorised, documented macros.

list.name: create_part
list.summary: Create a new, empty part document and make it active, ready for `create_sketch`.

list.name: create_reference_plane
list.summary: Add a reference plane offset from, at an angle to, or on a plane or flat face.

list.name: create_reference_point
list.summary: Add a reference point on an edge (at a distance or percentage along it) or at the centre of a face.

list.name: create_revolve
list.summary: Revolve a closed sketch around an axis, adding a solid to the active part.

list.name: create_section_view
list.summary: Cut a section view along a line across a drawing view.

list.name: create_sketch
list.summary: Open a new sketch on a plane of the active part, ready for lines, circles and other sketch entities.

list.name: create_sweep
list.summary: Sweep a closed profile sketch along a path sketch to make a solid (Insert > Boss/Base > Sweep).

list.name: create_technical_drawing
list.summary: Place a model's three standard views (front, top and side) on the active drawing sheet in one call.

list.name: create_template
list.summary: Create a part, assembly or drawing template file (.prtdot, .asmdot, .drwdot) with standard settings.

list.name: delete_feature
list.summary: Delete a feature or sketch from the active model, along with the features that depend on it.

list.name: discover_solidworks_docs
list.summary: Rebuild the SolidWorks API index on purpose. The lookups don't need it.

list.name: execute_macro
list.summary: Run a binary SolidWorks macro (.swp, or legacy .swb) in the running SolidWorks, calling its `main` procedure once.

list.name: execute_workflow
list.summary: Run a named sequence of tool steps, in order or in parallel, with an error policy.

list.name: exit_sketch
list.summary: Close the open sketch so a feature can use it.

list.name: export_dwg
list.summary: Export the active document to DWG, like File > Save As with the DWG type.

list.name: export_flat_pattern
list.summary: Export the active sheet-metal part's flat pattern to DXF or DWG, for laser or waterjet cutting.

list.name: export_iges
list.summary: Export the active document to IGES, like File > Save As with the IGES type.

list.name: export_image
list.summary: Save a picture of the active model in a standard view, as PNG or JPG, at a chosen size.

list.name: export_pdf
list.summary: Export the active document to PDF, like File > Save As with the PDF type.

list.name: export_step
list.summary: Export the active document to STEP, like File > Save As with the STEP type.

list.name: export_stl
list.summary: Export the active document to STL, like File > Save As with the STL type.

list.name: extract_template
list.summary: Capture a model's settings (custom properties, dimensions, units) as a reusable template file.

list.name: find_related_api_members
list.summary: Find SolidWorks API members related to an interface or member name.

list.name: generate_drawing_package
list.summary: Create a complete A3 drawing of a part or assembly in one call, and save it with a PDF.

list.name: generate_drawing_report
list.summary: Write a quality report that combines every drawing check.

list.name: generate_vba_assembly_insert
list.summary: Write a VBA macro that inserts a component into the active assembly at a point.

list.name: generate_vba_assembly_mates
list.summary: Write a VBA macro that adds a concentric, distance, parallel, perpendicular or coincident mate between two selected faces or edges.

list.name: generate_vba_batch_export
list.summary: Write a VBA macro that opens every matching file in a folder and saves a STEP copy of each to another folder.

list.name: generate_vba_code
list.summary: Write a VBA macro skeleton for an operation you describe: the SolidWorks connection, a check of the active document's type and optional error handling, with the operation itself left as a TODO.

list.name: generate_vba_drawing_dimensions
list.summary: Write a VBA macro that adds a dimension to the selected drawing entities and sets its precision.

list.name: generate_vba_drawing_views
list.summary: Write a VBA macro that places a model's standard views (front, top, right) on the active drawing.

list.name: generate_vba_extrusion
list.summary: Write a VBA macro that makes an extrusion with the full FeatureExtrusion options: both directions, draft, thin wall, end conditions.

list.name: generate_vba_file_operations
list.summary: Write a VBA macro that sets a custom property in every configuration, or runs Pack and Go on the active document.

list.name: generate_vba_macro_recorder
list.summary: Write a VBA starting point: a macro skeleton to fill in, or a note on starting and stopping SolidWorks' macro recorder.

list.name: generate_vba_part_modeling
list.summary: Write a VBA macro for a shell or a fillet on the active part.

list.name: generate_vba_revolve
list.summary: Write a VBA macro that revolves the selected sketch, with both-direction and thin-wall options.

list.name: get_custom_properties
list.summary: Read the active document's custom properties, such as PartNo, Description or Revision.

list.name: get_dimension
list.summary: Read one dimension of the active model by its full name, e.g. "D1@Sketch1".

list.name: get_file_properties
list.summary: Report the active document's file details: name, path, size, dates, type, configuration and unsaved changes.

list.name: get_mass_properties
list.summary: Measure the active part or assembly's mass properties: volume, surface area, mass, centre of mass and moments of inertia.

list.name: get_material
list.summary: Report the material assigned to the active part.

list.name: get_material_properties
list.summary: Report the physical properties of the active part's material: density, modulus, Poisson's ratio, strength.

list.name: get_model_info
list.summary: Report the active document's title, path, type, active configuration, unsaved changes, feature count and rebuild status.

list.name: get_selected_entities
list.summary: Describe the faces, edges and vertices selected in the SolidWorks window right now.

list.name: insert_bom_table
list.summary: Insert a bill-of-materials table for an assembly view on the active drawing.

list.name: insert_component
list.summary: Insert a part or sub-assembly file into the active assembly at a position in mm.

list.name: insert_model_dimensions
list.summary: Bring the model's dimensions into the active drawing's views, each dimension shown once.

list.name: list_available_materials
list.summary: List the materials in the installed SolidWorks material libraries.

list.name: list_components
list.summary: List the top-level components of the active assembly by instance name, e.g. "bracket-1".

list.name: list_configurations
list.summary: List the names of the active model's configurations.

list.name: list_drawing_views
list.summary: List the views on the active drawing, by name.

list.name: list_features
list.summary: List the feature tree of the active part or assembly, in order.

list.name: list_model_dimensions
list.summary: List every dimension in the active part or assembly with its full name and value.

list.name: list_open_documents
list.summary: List every document open in SolidWorks and say which one is active.

list.name: list_template_library
list.summary: List the templates in the shared template library.

list.name: load_assembly
list.summary: Open an assembly (.sldasm) from disk and make it the active document.

list.name: load_part
list.summary: Open a part (.sldprt) from disk and make it the active document.

list.name: lookup_api_interface
list.summary: List every method and property of a SolidWorks COM interface.

list.name: lookup_api_method
list.summary: Look up one SolidWorks API method or property: parameters, return type, description.

list.name: manage_design_table
list.summary: Create, read or update a design table (an Excel sheet that drives a model's configurations).

list.name: manage_file_properties
list.summary: Read or change the file-level properties of a SolidWorks file on disk.

list.name: measure_entities
list.summary: Measure faces, edges or vertices of the active model with SolidWorks' Measure tool.

list.name: mirror_feature
list.summary: Mirror solid bodies or features of the active part about a plane.

list.name: open_model
list.summary: Open a part, assembly or drawing from disk and make it the active document.

list.name: optimize_macro
list.summary: Suggest improvements to a macro's code for speed and reliability.

list.name: optimize_performance
list.summary: Review SolidWorks' performance settings and apply faster ones.

list.name: pack_and_go_assembly
list.summary: Copy an assembly and every file it uses into one folder that opens on its own.

list.name: pattern_circular
list.summary: Repeat features of the active part around an axis, e.g. a ring of bosses or ribs.

list.name: rebuild_model
list.summary: Rebuild the active model and report each feature that fails, with the reason and a fix.

list.name: rename_feature
list.summary: Rename a feature in the active model's feature tree.

list.name: reset_circuit_breaker
list.summary: Let calls through again to operations the server paused after repeated failures.

list.name: save_as
list.summary: Save the active document under a new path, as a SolidWorks file or in an exchange format such as STEP or IGES.

list.name: save_assembly
list.summary: Save the active assembly in place, or as a new .sldasm, optionally copying the parts it uses alongside.

list.name: save_body_as_part
list.summary: Save one solid body of the active multibody part as a new part file (Insert > Features > Save Bodies).

list.name: save_file
list.summary: Save the active document, to its own path or to a new path in its own format.

list.name: save_part
list.summary: Save the active part in place, or as a new .sldprt with the target path checked first.

list.name: save_to_template_library
list.summary: Add a template to a shared, categorised template library.

list.name: search_solidworks_api_help
list.summary: Search SolidWorks API interface and member names by keyword.

list.name: select_face_edges
list.summary: Select every edge of one face of the active part, ready for `add_fillet` or `add_chamfer` with no edge names.

list.name: select_feature
list.summary: Select a feature, sketch, plane or component by name in the active document.

list.name: set_component_state
list.summary: Fix or float a component of the active assembly, or make a sub-assembly rigid or flexible.

list.name: set_custom_property
list.summary: Create or overwrite one text custom property on the active document, e.g. PartNo or DrawnBy.

list.name: set_dimension
list.summary: Change one length dimension of the active model, in mm, and rebuild.

list.name: set_material
list.summary: Assign a library material to the active part, e.g. "AISI 1020" or "6061-T6 (SS)".

list.name: set_sheet_scale
list.summary: Set the active drawing sheet's scale, e.g. 1:2; views that use the sheet scale follow it.

list.name: set_units
list.summary: Set the active document's length units: mm, cm, m, in or ft.

list.name: sketch_circular_pattern
list.summary: Repeat sketch entities around the sketch origin, e.g. a bolt circle.

list.name: sketch_linear_pattern
list.summary: Repeat sketch entities in a straight line at a fixed spacing.

list.name: sketch_mirror
list.summary: Mirror sketch entities about a centreline in the open sketch.

list.name: sketch_offset
list.summary: Offset sketch entities by a distance in mm, outward or inward, e.g. for a wall or a clearance.

list.name: sketch_tutorial_simple_hole
list.summary: Demonstrate the sketch steps: draw a 5 mm circle at the origin on the Top plane and close the sketch.

list.name: start_macro_recording
list.summary: Start SolidWorks' macro recorder, to capture what the user does as a macro.

list.name: stop_macro_recording
list.summary: Stop the macro recorder and save the recorded macro.

list.name: suppress_feature
list.summary: Suppress or unsuppress a feature of the active model; suppressed features stay in the tree but are not built.

list.name: tutorial_simple_hole
list.summary: Draw a circle on a plane and cut it as a hole, as one worked example.

list.name: undo
list.summary: Undo the last operations in the active model (Edit > Undo).

list.name: update_sheet_format
list.summary: Change the active drawing's sheet format file and title-block fields.

list.name: update_title_block
list.summary: Fill in the active drawing's title-block fields (title, drawn by, drawing number and so on).

list.name: validate_drawing_completeness
list.summary: Check that a drawing carries everything needed to manufacture the part.

list.name: verify_model
list.summary: Check the active part or assembly against what you meant to build, one pass/fail check per expected value.
